question: This question runs on and on, well past the four hundred character cap that the schema sets for a spike question, because a question that long is not one question an experiment can answer but an unfocused ramble that the runner would have to narrow down anyway before it could possibly design an experiment around it, and narrowing is supposed to happen before the request is made rather than after the runner has already been paid for, so the schema refuses it outright. Long enough yet? Yes.
why_blocking: Questions over the cap are refused.
